free_text: Biopsy is recommended because the evidence strongly supports further investigation due to a PI-RADS 4 lesion in the right peripheral zone and a concerning PSA velocity of 1.47 ng/mL/yr. This finding, combined with the prior positive biopsy status and a rising PSA trend from 2.7 ng/mL to 4.7 ng/mL, mandates sampling to assess the extent of the lesion. The statistical prior suggesting deferral was overturned by the concrete imaging and trend data.
